v1.17.2b (2 April 2024) |feed_title = 🚽 Toilet Tower Defense Simulator 🚽 |previous_update = [[v1.17.0]] |next_update = [[v1.18.0|Mission Quests Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.17.2''' is the seventieth update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 1st of April 2024. This update was also given the name '''April Fools 2024 Update''', as it was an update released for April Fools. This update encompassed three updates, the main v1.17.2 update (released 1 April 2024) and two minor updates, the v1.17.2a (released 1 April 2024) and v1.17.2b (released 2 April 2024). ==Additions== ===Enemies=== *[[Toilet]] *[[Streamer]] *[[Chad]] *[[Metal Toilet]] *[[Ninja Toilet]] *[[Png Bot2]] *[[Png Bot]] *[[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] *[[Brick Man]] *[[Armored Toilet]] *[[Megatron Toilet]] *[[Pro Streamer]] *[[Arrow]] *[[Png Bot4]] *[[Png Bot3]] *[[Toilet Boss]] ===Maps=== *[[Headache Headquarters]] ===Miscellanous=== *[[Brain Rot]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== *Slightly updated the lobby by removing the eggs and updating the BelowNatural statue. *Updated {{Color|Premium|Toilet}} [[Scout]], {{Color|Premium|Toilet}} [[Soldier]], {{Color|Premium|Chad}} [[Minigunner]], {{Color|Deluxe|TeeVee}} [[Electroshocker]] and {{Color|Deluxe|Speaker Titan}} [[Accelerator]] icons. *Fixed {{Color|Premium|Toilet}} [[Scout]], {{Color|Premium|Toilet}} [[Soldier]], {{Color|Premium|Chad}} [[Minigunner]], {{Color|Deluxe|TeeVee}} [[Electroshocker]] and {{Color|Deluxe|Speaker Titan}} [[Accelerator]] breaking tower icons in the tower hotbar during matches. *Fixed {{Color|Premium|Toilet}} [[Scout]], {{Color|Premium|Toilet}} [[Soldier]], {{Color|Premium|Chad}} [[Minigunner]], {{Color|Deluxe|TeeVee}} [[Electroshocker]] and {{Color|Deluxe|Speaker Titan}} [[Accelerator]] not being selectable in the intermission lobby. *Fixed {{Color|Deluxe|TeeVee}} skin not having any lightning visuals or sounds at Level 4-5. *Fixed {{Color|Deluxe|Speaker Titan}} having broken animations and cosmetics. *Fixed {{Color|Deluxe|Speaker Titan}} placement footprint not disappearing after being sold, blocking placement. *Fixed player icons not appearing on the mode they voted for icons. :In '''v1.17.2a''' *[[Toilet Boss]] health decreased from 180,000 to 150,000. *Fixed [[Brain Rot]] being disabled upon restarting. *Fixed [[Headache Headquarters]] not giving out
